findings.title: CDC guidance
findings.headline: CDC advice for visiting general
findings.meaning: What CDC recommends when visiting family and friends
findings.text:
What CDC recommends when visiting family and friends:
- If you have respiratory symptoms (fever, cough, runny nose), stay home and away from others. Resume normal activities only after at least 24 hours of improving symptoms with no fever (without fever-reducing medicine), then take extra care for 5 days: cleaner air, hand hygiene, a well-fitted mask, distance and testing, especially around people at higher risk. [1]
- CDC's core prevention steps are staying up to date on vaccines, washing hands, and cleaner air where people gather. Masks, distance and testing add protection when illness is rising in the community or when you are with someone at higher risk. [2]
This summarises CDC guidance (pages retrieved 2026-10-26); it is not personal medical advice.
